definitions.short: Shur , a region of the Desert
definitions.full: H7793. Shur III. שׁוּר proper name, of a location southwest of Palestine, on east border of Egypt ; — Gen 16:7 (J; שׁ ׳דֶּרֶךְ ), 20:1 (E), towards Egypt 25:18 (J), 1Sam 15:7 , שׁ֫וּרָה 27:8 ; ׳מִדְּבַּרשֿׁ Exod 15:22 (J). — Often supposed to denote properly the 'wall' or line of fortresses, built by Egyptian kings across isthmus of Suez; but dubious: compare Dr Hast. DB SHUR .
